title: Just found out about this sub from a youtube rabbit hole video. Currently shitting my pants.
content: I've had several, um, I guess MallWorld dreams, including dreams that lead from a library to the Mall and then back again. This additionally includes semi or fully lucid dreams that were either triggered by MallWorld or the characters in MallWorld. Even the semi-lucid dreams are always special -- not like a normal dream. If I'm in the mall, I'm already semi-lucid, and even then it's not just a normal semi-lucid dream that happens outside the mall -- they're pointed, somehow. It feels like they mean something. Jesus christ I'm like right now remembering dreams about being physically outside the mall now, in the parking lot of this place. So much is coming back all at once. Um, AMA or something? Idk I was watching this video while applying for jobs and had to take a break to come here and make this post. Are there similar communities for the library? What about a giant, shifting city? Literally shaking rn.
